description: This PHP source file defines the class OAuthPluginBase, which extends ExternalAPIBase and implements ExternalOAuthAPIPlugin. It provides OAuth-related functionality, including setting up OAuth parameters, loading data from EAPM beans, checking login status, and performing OAuth authentication flows such as obtaining request and access tokens.

classes.name: OAuthPluginBase
classes.description: A class that manages OAuth authentication workflows for external APIs within the SuiteCRM environment, including token management and OAuth URL retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for OAuthPluginBase, currently does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: setupOauthKeys
methods.description: Initializes OAuth consumer key and secret from the connector properties, sets a flag indicating keys are initialized.

methods.name: loadEAPM
methods.description: Loads OAuth tokens from an EAPM bean into the object.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Checks if the user is logged in, including OAuth authentication status.

methods.name: quickCheckLogin
methods.description: Performs a quick check of OAuth token presence to verify login status.

methods.name: checkOauthLogin
methods.description: Verifies current OAuth token presence; initiates OAuth login flow if tokens are missing.

methods.name: getOauthParams
methods.description: Returns OAuth parameters stored in oauthParams.

methods.name: getOauthRequestURL
methods.description: Returns the OAuth request token URL.

methods.name: getOauthAccessURL
methods.description: Returns the OAuth access token URL.

methods.name: getOauth
methods.description: Creates and returns a SugarOAuth object configured with current OAuth credentials.

methods.name: oauthLogin
methods.description: Performs the OAuth login flow, including obtaining request tokens, redirecting for authorization, and exchanging for access tokens, then stores tokens in EAPM bean.
